title: Tessera theme
description: A Tessera theme, version 1. Values are colors, bounded numbers and keywords only: raw CSS, URLs and @import cannot be expressed. The app enforces the same rules (packages/theme/src/validate.ts) and refuses files over 16 KiB.

id.description: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Must not reuse a built-in preset id.

mode.description: Whether the theme is light or dark; sets the browser's color-scheme.

surface.description: Panels and sidebars on the background.

borderStrong.description: Control outlines (inputs, buttons). At least 3:1 against every surface.

text.description: Body text. At least 4.5:1 against every surface.

textMuted.description: Secondary text. At least 4.5:1 against every surface.

accent.description: Links, the primary action and the brand mark. At least 4.5:1 against every surface.

onAccent.description: Text on an accent fill. At least 4.5:1 against accent.

focus.description: The keyboard focus ring. At least 3:1 against every surface.

danger.description: Errors and destructive actions, as text. At least 4.5:1 against background and surface.

success.description: Success, as text. At least 4.5:1 against background and surface.

warning.description: Warnings, as text. At least 4.5:1 against background and surface.

selection.description: Selected text background. Text must stay 4.5:1 on it.

elevation.description: flat: borders only. raised: soft shadows on raised surfaces.

motion.description: false turns transitions and animations off. The OS reduced-motion setting turns them off regardless.

fontFamily.description: A system font stack; Tessera loads no font files.
